Constantīnus , i, m., C. Flavius Vaferius Claudius Constantinus,
I.Constantine, a well-known Roman emperor, born A. D. 274, died A. D. 323, Eutr. 10, 2 sqq.; Lact. Mort. Pers. 18 sqq.; Amm. 21, 10, 8.—Hence, Constantīnĭānus , a, um, adj., of or pertaining to Constantine: “genus,” Amm. 27, 5, 1 : “lavacrum,” id. 27, 3, 8 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
